name: Cara Lee
source:
A graduating student in college. To celebrate their upcoming graduation next semester, she and her friends go on a hike to a popular mountain. However, it starts storming in the middle of their hike. Along the way, a minor landslide knocks her unconscious, and when she wakes up, she finds herself alone in a dark and scary forest.

(Taken from [url=https://ainoshiki.wordpress.com/games/once-upon-a-hallows-eve/]dev page[/url])
